purpose: Teach: 文中/合弁/集大成/係長/特設/別冊/交替/年率

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、調書の文中表現に厳密です
lines.en: The police keep strict standards on the language in official statements.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Clean attack on the opening. Even pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone explaining procedure, not defending it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、合弁警備会社との連携、安心です
lines.en: Yes. It's reassuring that the police are coordinating with the private security company.
lines.style: Responsive and attentive. Slight lift on 'Yes' to show agreement and engagement. Warm but businesslike. Brief pause before the main clause.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯活動の集大成として大規模演習を実施します
lines.en: The police will conduct a large-scale drill as a capstone to the community crime-prevention initiative.
lines.style: Clear, declarative. Steady tempo. Weight on the word 'conduct' — this is significant. No inflection softening at the end. The voice of official announcement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、係長級の事件担当者がご対応ですね
lines.en: I see. So a section chief or above will be assigned to the case, then?
lines.style: Seeking confirmation without doubt. Gentle rise on the question mark. Respectful but not deferential. Engaged listener checking his understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯特設窓口を商店街に設けます
lines.en: The police will establish a temporary crime-prevention information window in the shopping district.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Even pacing. No pause before the location detail — this is one continuous thought. Official voice, no emotion layered in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、別冊報告書も発行されますね
lines.en: Understood. And a supplementary report will be issued as well, correct?
lines.style: Confirming without pressing. Polite uptick on 'correct?' Light touch — not interrogating, just making sure the details are being tracked correctly.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、夜勤の交替制を厳格に運用します
lines.en: The police will enforce a strict rotating night-shift schedule.
lines.style: Measured and firm. Weight on 'strict' — this is deliberate policy, not casual procedure. Even tone throughout. The voice of someone laying out non-negotiable protocol.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正融資の年率について捜査ですね
lines.en: Yes. You're investigating the annual interest rates on those illegal loans, then?
lines.style: Sharp and focused. Quick agreement followed by a direct question. Suddenly more alert — this touches on the real investigation. No hesitation on the sensitive term 'illegal loans'.
